header.label: Construction planning
header.title: Open Planner Studio
header.desc: Open-source construction planning with Gantt charts, Critical Path Method, and native IFC 4.3 file format. Built for the AEC industry.

gantt.title: Gantt charts
gantt.desc: Interactive Canvas-rendered Gantt diagrams with drag and drop, zoom, and timeline navigation.

cpm.title: Critical Path Method
cpm.desc: Automatic CPM calculation with critical path identification and float analysis.

wbs.title: Work Breakdown Structure
wbs.desc: Hierarchical task structure with collapsible chapters. Excel-style table editor with inline editing.

ifc.title: IFC 4.3 native
ifc.desc: Save and open planning files in IFC 4.3 format (buildingSMART standard). Built-in IFC code editor with generate and apply.

resources.title: Resource management
resources.desc: Manage labor, equipment, and subcontractors. Construction-specific features: holidays, building recess, inspection moments, and phasing.

bim4d.title: 4D BIM-ready
bim4d.desc: Link planning tasks to IFC building model elements for 4D construction sequence visualization.

reporting.title: Reporting
reporting.desc: Live print preview in the ribbon with configurable report options. Context menu for quick task actions.

multilingual.title: Multilingual
multilingual.desc: Interface in 6 languages: Nederlands, English, Francais, Deutsch, Espanol, and Zhongwen.

ribbon.title: Ribbon toolbar
ribbon.desc: Microsoft Office-style ribbon with tabs: Start, Planning, View, Settings, Table, IFC, and Report.

tauri.title: Tauri 2.0
tauri.desc: Native desktop application with Rust backend.

react.title: React 18 + TypeScript
react.desc: Component-based UI with Zustand + Immer state management.

canvas.title: HTML5 Canvas 2D
canvas.desc: Gantt chart rendering. TailwindCSS styling, Vite 5 build.

whatsnew.label: New in v2026.6.0 · testers wanted
whatsnew.title: Plan construction with open BIM — and help us test
whatsnew.desc: This version brings native IFC 4.3 (your schedule is an IFC file), a 4D link to your BIM model, automatic Critical Path Method (CPM) and an extended reporting tab with live print preview — plus construction-specific resources like holidays, inspection moments and phasing.
whatsnew.testers: We are looking for testers: work planners, schedulers, project leads and BIM coordinators. Try Open Planner Studio right in your browser and tell us what you think — your feedback helps shape where it goes.
